records.source: It's a pleasure to meet you. I'm Harvey, the local doctor.#$e#I perform regular check-ups and medical procedures for all the residents of Pelican Town. It's rewarding work.#$e#I hope you'll find your own work equally rewarding, in time.$h
records.translation: Ikinagagalak kitang makilala. Ako si Harvey, ang doktor dito.#$e#Nagsasagawa ako ng regular na pagsusuri at pamamaraang medikal para sa lahat ng residente ng Bayan ng Pelican. Kasiya-siyang trabaho ito.#$e#Sana sa paglipas ng panahon ay matagpuan mo ring kasiya-siya ang sarili mong trabaho.$h

records.source: Oh! Thank you very much! I didn't expect anyone to know it was my birthday today.$h
records.translation: Ah! Maraming salamat! Hindi ko inasahang may makaaalam na kaarawan ko ngayon.$h

records.source: Oh! It's a... well, it's something. I didn't expect anyone to know it was my birthday today.
records.translation: Ah! Isa itong... aba, isang bagay. Hindi ko inasahang may makaaalam na kaarawan ko ngayon.

records.source: You're giving me this? I'm honored. Thank you!
records.translation: Ibinibigay mo ito sa akin? Isang karangalan. Salamat!

records.source: Oh! You... want to dance with me?$4#$b#...Yes. I'd love to!$h
records.translation: Ah! Gusto mong... sumayaw kasama ko?$4#$b#...Oo. Gustong-gusto ko!$h

records.source: I brought some medical supplies, just in case. Be careful out there!
records.translation: Nagdala ako ng ilang panustos na medikal, kung sakali. Mag-ingat ka sa labas!

records.source: The first time this happened, we were all worried that the rain might be dangerous.#$b#But what if it's actually healthy for the body? Who knows... The plants seem to respond well to it, at least.
records.translation: Noong una itong nangyari, nag-alala kaming lahat na baka mapanganib ang ulan.#$b#Pero paano kung talagang nakabubuti ito sa katawan? Sino ang nakaaalam... Mukhang maganda naman ang tugon dito ng mga halaman.

records.source: It's for me? Thank you! This will be fantastic drizzled on some pasta.$h
records.translation: Para sa akin? Salamat! Magiging napakasarap nito kapag ipinatak-patak sa pasta.$h

records.source: For me? What a gift! This looks fantastic!$h#$b#You know, on a physiological level, I wouldn't advise the consumption of alcohol...#$b#But there's no denying the benefit of kicking back and enjoying a glass of fine Stardew Valley wine!$h
records.translation: Para sa akin? Napakagandang regalo! Mukhang napakasarap nito!$h#$b#Alam mo, sa antas ng pisyolohiya, hindi ko maipapayo ang pag-inom ng alak...#$b#Pero hindi maikakaila ang pakinabang ng pagpapahinga at pagtikim ng isang baso ng pinong alak ng Stardew Valley!$h

records.source: I've been working on an 'animal checklist' for a few years now. I want to observe every species living in the valley!
records.translation: Ilang taon na akong gumagawa ng “talaan ng mga hayop”. Gusto kong mapagmasdan ang bawat uring naninirahan sa lambak!

records.source: I tried making my own pickles one time...$s#$e#Um, let me put it this way... The frogs we dissected in high school smelled like roses in comparison...
records.translation: Minsan ay sinubukan kong gumawa ng sarili kong atsara...$s#$e#Um, ganito ko na lang sasabihin... Amoy-rosas ang mga palakang dinisekta namin sa mataas na paaralan kung ihahambing doon...

records.source: As a small town doctor, you can't help but form a personal connection with your patients. That can be both good and bad...
records.translation: Bilang doktor sa munting bayan, hindi mo maiiwasang magkaroon ng personal na ugnayan sa mga pasyente. May mabuti at masamang dulot iyon...

records.source: Well now that you know my secret, I might as well give you an update... I was significantly less winded after aerobics class this week!
records.translation: Ngayong alam mo na ang lihim ko, mabuting ibalita ko na rin... Hindi na ako gaanong hinihingal pagkatapos ng klase sa aerobics ngayong linggo!

records.source: I got such a good workout during aerobics class, I think I can treat myself to some pasta primavera tonight...$h
records.translation: Napakaganda ng ehersisyo ko sa klase ng aerobics kaya sa tingin ko ay maaari kong ilibre ang sarili ng pasta primavera ngayong gabi...$h

records.source: I don't know why I was ashamed about being in dance aerobics class. My legs have become so strong, I should feel as bold as a lion!
records.translation: Hindi ko alam kung bakit ikinahihiya kong nasa klase ako ng sayaw na aerobics. Napakalakas na ng mga binti ko kaya dapat kasingtapang ako ng leon!

records.source: I've never told anyone about my airplane hobby before... I guess I just feel comfortable talking to you.
records.translation: Hindi ko pa nasabi kaninuman ang hilig ko sa eroplano... Marahil komportable lang akong kausapin ka.

records.source: As a doctor, you can only do so much to help your patients...#$e#I've made the mistake of getting too emotionally involved in the past... I won't let that happen again...$s
records.translation: Bilang doktor, limitado lamang ang magagawa mo upang tulungan ang mga pasyente...#$e#Nagkamali akong masyadong masangkot ang damdamin ko noon... Hindi ko hahayaang mangyari ulit iyon...$s

records.source: I've never felt like this before...$l
records.translation: Hindi pa ako nakaramdam nang ganito...$l

records.source: I've been thinking about you so much, I can hardly do my work.$l
records.translation: Lagi kitang naiisip kaya halos hindi ko magawa ang trabaho ko.$l

records.source: Maru's been unusually cheerful lately... I hear you may have something to do with that.
records.translation: Mas masayahin si Maru kaysa karaniwan nitong mga nakaraan... Narinig kong baka may kinalaman ka roon.

records.source: Congratulations on your marriage, @. Maru's already informed me that she'll continue to work at the clinic, which is a relief!
records.translation: Binabati kita sa kasal mo, @. Sinabi na sa akin ni Maru na patuloy siyang magtatrabaho sa klinika, kaya napakalaking ginhawa!

records.source: This is the happiest moment of my life...$l
records.translation: Ito ang pinakamasayang sandali ng buhay ko...$l

records.source: Sunscreen? Check...#$b#Sun hat? Check...
records.translation: Kremang panangga sa araw? Handa...#$b#Sombrerong panangga sa araw? Handa...

records.source: If you get burnt, a little aloe vera cream might help soothe the skin.
records.translation: Kung masunog ka sa araw, maaaring makatulong ang kaunting krema ng aloe vera upang paginhawahin ang balat.

records.source: I combed the whole beach for glass. We wouldn't want anyone to get a cut on their foot!
records.translation: Hinalughog ko ang buong dalampasigan para sa bubog. Ayaw nating may masugatan sa paa!

records.source: It's nice to have an opportunity to relax now and then.#$b#The trouble is actually letting go of your worries...$s
records.translation: Masarap magkaroon ng pagkakataong magpahinga paminsan-minsan.#$b#Ang mahirap ay ang tunay na pagbitaw sa mga alalahanin...$s

records.source: It's important to stay hydrated in this heat. I'm going to ask Gus if he has any coconut water!$h
records.translation: Mahalagang uminom ng sapat na tubig sa init na ito. Tatanungin ko si Gus kung mayroon siyang tubig ng niyog!$h

records.source: I'll let you in on a little secret... I can only swim with floaties.$s
records.translation: May ibubulong akong munting lihim... Nakalalangoy lamang ako gamit ang mga salbabida sa braso.$s

records.source: I've been looking forward to it all afternoon! You look radiant in the fresh spring air, my love.$l
records.translation: Buong hapon ko itong inaabangan! Nagniningning ka sa sariwang hangin ng tagsibol, mahal ko.$l

records.source: Oh! I'm sorry... I, er... have plans to ask someone else.$s
records.translation: Ah! Paumanhin... Ako, ah... may balak akong yayain na iba.$s

records.source: I... I can't look at you. Please spare me any more pain.$s
records.translation: Hindi... Hindi kita kayang tingnan. Pakiusap, huwag mo na akong saktan pa.$s

records.source: ...Y...You...?$s#$b#*gulp*... I... I think I'm going to be sick...$s
records.translation: ...I...Ikaw...?$s#$b#*lumunok*... Ako... Sa tingin ko ay masusuka ako...$s

records.source: I'm busy with my work. I can't speak to you.$s
records.translation: Abala ako sa trabaho. Hindi kita makakausap.$s

records.source: I want you back in my life, @. I'm willing to forget what happened.$s
records.translation: Gusto kong bumalik ka sa buhay ko, @. Handa kong kalimutan ang nangyari.$s

records.source: We sell a few over-the-counter medicines at the clinic... feel free to stop by if you're feeling exhausted.#$b#I know that being a farmer is pretty tiring work... don't overdo it!
records.translation: Nagbebenta kami sa klinika ng ilang gamot na hindi kailangan ng reseta... Malaya kang dumaan kung pagod na pagod ka.#$b#Alam kong nakapapagod ang pagiging magsasaka... Huwag mong pagurin nang sobra ang sarili mo!

records.source: I feel responsible for the health of this whole community... it's kind of stressful.#$e#It's a pretty small community, and I'm fortunate to be able to build a good relationship with my patients.
records.translation: Pananagutan ko ang kalusugan ng buong komunidad na ito... medyo nakababahala iyon.#$e#Munting komunidad ito, at mapalad akong magkaroon ng mabuting ugnayan sa mga pasyente.

records.source: I'd like to stay in Stardew Valley for a while. I'm finally starting to feel involved in the community.#$e#It feels good to know that you're useful.
records.translation: Gusto kong manatili sa Stardew Valley nang matagal-tagal. Sa wakas ay nagsisimula akong maging bahagi ng komunidad.#$e#Masarap malamang kapaki-pakinabang ka.

records.source: Oh! Hi, @.$l#$e#Do you... have any medical questions?$l
records.translation: Ah! Kumusta, @.$l#$e#Mayroon ka bang... anumang tanong na medikal?$l

records.source: Feel free to stop by my office if you're ever feeling ill.#$e#You're young, though. You'll probably stay healthy without trying.$h
records.translation: Malaya kang dumaan sa tanggapan ko kung sakaling sumama ang pakiramdam mo.#$e#Pero bata ka pa. Malamang mananatili kang malusog nang hindi nagsisikap.$h

records.source: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#Don't overwork yourself, @. Doctor's orders!#$e#If our farmers get sick, where will we get our food? We need you!$h|Don't overwork yourself, @. Doctor's orders!#$e#Your health is important to me.$l
records.translation: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#Huwag mong pagurin nang sobra ang sarili mo, @. Utos ng doktor!#$e#Kung magkasakit ang mga magsasaka natin, saan tayo kukuha ng pagkain? Kailangan ka namin!$h|Huwag mong pagurin nang sobra ang sarili mo, @. Utos ng doktor!#$e#Mahalaga sa akin ang kalusugan mo.$l

records.source: I'd like to get to know you better, @. Let's put aside our doctor-patient relationship.
records.translation: Gusto kitang makilala nang mas mabuti, @. Isantabi natin ang ugnayan natin bilang doktor at pasyente.

records.source: It's nice to have a friend in town.$h
records.translation: Masarap magkaroon ng kaibigan sa bayan.$h

records.source: You have a really healthy glow. That's good.$h
records.translation: Maaliwalas at malusog ang kutis mo. Mabuti iyan.$h

records.source: Remember to cover your mouth when you sneeze.#$e#Then make sure to wash your hands.
records.translation: Tandaang takpan ang bibig kapag bumabahing.#$e#Pagkatapos ay tiyaking hugasan ang mga kamay.

records.source: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#As a doctor, I'm well aware of the benefits of home-cooked food. But I'm so busy, I have a hard time bringing myself to cook.$s|It's a lot of work, being a doctor. I don't eat as well as I should.$s#$e#If I didn't live alone I think it would be easier.$l
records.translation: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#Bilang doktor, alam na alam ko ang pakinabang ng lutong-bahay. Pero napakaabala ko kaya nahihirapan akong magluto.$s|Napakaraming trabaho ang pagiging doktor. Hindi ako kumakain nang kasingbuti ng nararapat.$s#$e#Sa tingin ko, mas madali kung hindi ako namumuhay nang mag-isa.$l

records.source: Nutrition is important, so make sure and eat well. Try to increase your vegetable intake!#$e#Home-cooked meals are best. Do you cook?
records.translation: Mahalaga ang nutrisyon, kaya tiyaking kumain nang mabuti. Subukan mong dagdagan ang gulay na kinakain mo!#$e#Pinakamabuti ang lutong-bahay. Nagluluto ka ba?

records.source: It's a beautiful day, isn't it?#$e#I wish I had less work to do.$s
records.translation: Napakagandang araw, hindi ba?#$e#Sana mas kaunti ang trabaho ko.$s

records.source: If you want to hang out in my apartment, that's okay with me. I live above the clinic.
records.translation: Kung gusto mong magpalipas ng oras sa apartment ko, ayos lang sa akin. Nakatira ako sa itaas ng klinika.

records.source: Stop by my place if you ever need a confidential check-up.$l
records.translation: Dumaan ka sa tahanan ko kung kailangan mo ng kompidensiyal na pagsusuri.$l

records.source: Can I do anything for you?#$e#Take care.
records.translation: May magagawa ba ako para sa iyo?#$e#Mag-ingat ka.

records.source: I came here because I liked the small-town atmosphere, and the potential for a holistic approach to patient care.#$e#I've grown to really love it.$h
records.translation: Pumunta ako rito dahil nagustuhan ko ang kapaligiran ng munting bayan at ang posibilidad ng holistikong pangangalaga sa pasyente.#$e#Talagang minahal ko na ito.$h

records.source: *Sigh*... I'm starting to feel kind of old...#$e#The older you get the more memories you're burdened with. It can be overwhelming.$s#$e#I think I'll stay younger with you around.$l
records.translation: *Buntong-hininga*... Nagsisimula na akong makaramdam ng pagtanda...#$e#Habang tumatanda ka, mas maraming alaala ang nagpapabigat sa iyo. Maaari itong maging nakalulula.$s#$e#Sa tingin ko, mananatili akong mas bata kapag kasama ka.$l

records.source: Hmm... I'm struggling to make ends meet. I don't have enough patients.#$e#I guess I should try to get patients from the neighboring towns...
records.translation: Hmm... Nahihirapan akong pagkasyahin ang kita. Wala akong sapat na pasyente.#$e#Marahil dapat kong subukang kumuha ng mga pasyente mula sa mga kalapit na bayan...

records.source: Imagine having a patient's life completely in your hands, and failing to keep them alive... that's something that will haunt you forever.$s
records.translation: Isipin mong lubos na nasa mga kamay mo ang buhay ng pasyente at nabigo kang panatilihin siyang buhay... Habambuhay kang uusigin niyon.$s

records.source: Thanks, @.$h#$b#You see, George, I'm just trying to help you.
records.translation: Salamat, @.$h#$b#Kita mo, George, sinusubukan lang kitang tulungan.

records.source: *Sigh*$s#$b#Look, George. If you want to behave like this I'm going to have to tell your wife. I don't think she'll be happy.
records.translation: *Buntong-hininga*$s#$b#Makinig ka, George. Kung magpapatuloy kang kumilos nang ganito, kailangan kong sabihin sa asawa mo. Sa tingin ko, hindi siya matutuwa.

records.source: Thanks, @. I appreciate that.$h
records.translation: Salamat, @. Pinahahalagahan ko iyon.$h

records.source: *Sigh*... rude.$s
records.translation: *Buntong-hininga*... bastos.$s

records.source: Oh! Hospitals make you nervous, huh?#$b#Just try and relax. I'm here to help.$h
records.translation: Ah! Kinakabahan ka sa mga ospital, ano?#$b#Subukan mo lang magrelaks. Narito ako upang tumulong.$h

records.source: Okay. That makes sense.
records.translation: Sige. May katuturan iyon.

records.source: Um. Okay... If you say so.$s
records.translation: Um. Sige... Kung iyon ang sabi mo.$s

records.source: ...You're right.#$b#...Thanks.
records.translation: ...Tama ka.#$b#...Salamat.

records.source: *sigh*$s
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*$s

records.source: It's okay to get a moderate amount of sunlight. Just don't get burnt.#$e#Okay. Take care! Stay healthy.
records.translation: Ayos lang ang katamtamang sikat ng araw. Huwag ka lang masunog sa araw.#$e#Sige. Mag-ingat ka! Manatiling malusog.

records.source: Exercise is important, but don't get too exhausted, or you might end up at my clinic!#$e#Make sure and listen to your body.
records.translation: Mahalaga ang ehersisyo, pero huwag mapagod nang sobra dahil baka mapunta ka sa klinika ko!#$e#Tiyaking pakinggan ang katawan mo.

records.source: People don't get sick much during the summer. That's nice, but it also means less business for me.
records.translation: Hindi gaanong nagkakasakit ang mga tao tuwing tag-init. Mabuti iyon, pero nangangahulugan din ng mas kaunting negosyo para sa akin.

records.source: Have you been going into the mines, @?#$e#It's a dangerous place. I recommend against it.
records.translation: Pumapasok ka ba sa mga Minahan, @?#$e#Mapanganib na lugar iyon. Hindi ko iyon ipinapayo.

records.source: When you eat certain foods you'll perform better.#$e#Eating a 'Farmer's Lunch' will give you the nutrition you need to water and harvest crops better!
records.translation: Mas mahusay ang magagawa mo kapag kumain ka ng ilang uri ng pagkain.#$e#Bibigyan ka ng “Tanghalian ng Magsasaka” ng nutrisyong kailangan upang mas mahusay magdilig at mag-ani ng mga pananim!

records.source: It's flu season, so you'd better be extra careful.#$e#Make sure to wash your hands often.
records.translation: Panahon ng trangkaso, kaya mabuting mag-ingat ka nang husto.#$e#Tiyaking madalas hugasan ang mga kamay.

records.source: I hate to say this, but I do make a lot more money during flu season.#$e#I guess if people stopped getting sick, I'd be out of business.#$e#Don't get the wrong idea! I want people to be healthy... really!
records.translation: Ayaw ko mang sabihin, mas malaki talaga ang kinikita ko sa panahon ng trangkaso.#$e#Marahil malulugi ako kung hindi na nagkakasakit ang mga tao.#$e#Huwag kang magkamali ng akala! Gusto kong maging malusog ang mga tao... talaga!
